evidence: Static review of all 43 files of the frozen task; no runtime evidence is needed for this row and none is claimed. (1) Live credentials: a scan for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-or-, AKIA, ghp_, xox*, AIza, JWT, PEM blocks, Bearer literals) over every task file returned no match. The only credential fields are task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` (a template, not a literal) and task.toml:35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`; `diff` against the frozen template task.toml shows only name, description, keywords, difficulty, category, provenance and arena_slice differ, so the [verifier.env] block is the unchanged shared block. All other hits for token/secret/password are syntax-token wording or the per-run preview nonce generated with `crypto.randomUUID()` (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:386), not a stored secret. The product has no sign-in (instruction.md: `without signing in`), so there are no demo credentials at all. (2) Real personal data: environment/assets/seed_data.json is 149 bytes, `"snippets": []` plus a note; no names, addresses or phone numbers anywhere. The only e-mail address in the task is the template's `turing@local.invalid` (environment/Dockerfile:20, reserved TLD). (3) Host paths: no match for drive-letter paths, /Users/, /home/<user>, /mnt/<drive>, the workspace name or the author's name or account in any file; solution/solve.sh resolves its source with `$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/app" && pwd -P)` and writes only to /app. (4) Remote fetch: solution/solve.sh contains no curl, wget, npm, npx, pip or git clone; it copies the prebuilt app. solution/app/package.json pins every dependency to an exact version and package-lock.json has 178 `resolved` entries, all on https://registry.npmjs.org, each with an `integrity` hash (178 of 178). The served pages load only same-origin `/assets/index.js` and `/assets/index.css`; the only absolute URLs in the built bundle are XML namespaces and library comment or error-link strings, and the only runtime `fetch` is the app's own relative API call (solution/app/src/app.tsx:12). environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (`diff -q` silent), with exact npm and pip versions; their base images are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned and apt packages are unversioned, which is template-controlled and is what the skill's checks 10 and 15 accept as pinned, so it is not a task defect under the delivery profile (public network in both phases). (5) Injection payload: no instruction-override or score-steering phrasing in the brief, the six notes, seed data, tests/app_context.md, any prompt.md or judge.toml; no URL appears anywhere under tests/. A hidden-character scan (Unicode Cf/Co/Cn and control characters) is clean for every authored file; the only hits are in the minified third-party bundle solution/app/public/assets/index.js (zero-width and bidi code points consistent with the bundled parser and formatter Unicode tables), which is not shown to the builder or pasted into a judge prompt. No long base64 blobs in any file. Evidence index hashes for run_golden.sh, results/runtime.json and results/editor.json were recomputed and match; they do not bear on this row.
